AllocationAttribution: whole-process Go heap TotalAlloc delta; business DTO/string/JSON, database/sql, driver and harness included; native allocations and framework-only attribution unavailable
BatchRowsScope: frozen reference value; database/sql exposes per-row iteration, with no row-batch size control

CgoCalls.Scope: runtime.NumCgoCall process-wide Go-to-C calls during steady operations; not a cross-runtime equivalent of Korda command FFI or libpq protocol submissions

Compilation: optimized native Go executable with only the selected database driver; no .NET runtime

Database.DatabaseVersion: PostgreSQL 18.0 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by clang version 23.1.5 (https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project 392dfff97d29b59d77e5cac6d4b6ef2585fe7117), 64-bit
Database.PreparedPolicy: constant SQL and parameter shape reuse; SQLite cached public statements; PostgreSQL unnamed QueryExecModeExec, no server statement or description cache
Database.TransactionPolicy: READ COMMITTED, read-write; ordinary database/sql transaction APIs; commit/rollback awaited before persisted-state read

GCScope: Go non-generational NumGC and pause deltas for all process goroutines; not .NET Gen0/Gen1/Gen2

Idle.Scope: after worker/statement/connection/pool close; no forced GC; outside steady allocation and duration boundaries

LatencyMethod: base-2 histogram with 128 subdivisions per exponent; selected-bin upper bounds; successful operations only; rejected arrivals have no synthetic latency
QueryReuseContract: SQLite retained prepared read statements; PostgreSQL pgx exec mode with no retained server prepared statements; transaction command construction included
SQLCounterScope: business SQL/control calls in successful operations only; failed-operation partial calls, driver-internal messages and network round trips are not counted
Scheduling: fixed offered rate; bounded FIFO admission; explicit rejection; global arrival index selects case; successful scheduled response includes admission delay
